title: Computing Demand Overloaded! OpenAI Suspends New User Sign-ups and Upgrades for ChatGPT Pro at the $200 Tier

content_html:
On September 10th local time, OpenAI officially released a new announcement stating that starting from now, the registration of new users and level upgrades for the ChatGPT Pro 200-dollar plan (i.e., Pro 20X) will be temporarily suspended.

This suspension affects a wide range of users, including all existing users and potential new users currently using Free, Go, Plus, and the 100-dollar Pro plan. For existing users who have subscribed to the 200-dollar plan, the official stated that their current benefits will not be affected at this time, and both new and existing users of the 100-dollar plan can continue to use it normally.

Regarding the specific rules of this adjustment, OpenAI clearly outlined the restrictions: existing users of the 200-dollar plan who choose to cancel their subscription or downgrade will not be able to repurchase this plan after the current billing cycle ends. This restriction will continue until the official announces the end of the suspension.
